|game_text=Deploy on a Dagobah site. Target a mentor on Dagobah and an apprentice who has completed Jedi Test #4. Attempt when apprentice is present at the beginning of your control phase. Turn apprentice upside down (cannot move and power = 0). At end of turn, turn apprentice right side up (restored): Place on apprentice. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. Reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck and place one upside down on this Jedi Test. Once per turn (twice if [Special Edition] At Peace on table), whenever you are about to draw a card for destiny, you may instead use the upside-down card (which remains on Jedi Test).
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[It Is The Future You See (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. * '''PC-E1''' ([[It Is The Future You See (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 25]] (8 August 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114001541/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>, page 9, file created 10 August 2025: “Deploy on a Dagobah site. Target a mentor on Dagobah and an apprentice who has completed Jedi Test #4. Attempt when apprentice is present at the beginning of your control phase. Turn apprentice upside down (cannot move and power = 0). At end of turn, turn apprentice right side up (restored): Place on apprentice. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. Reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck and place one upside down on this Jedi Test. Once per turn (twice if [Special Edition] At Peace on table), whenever you are about to draw a card for destiny, you may instead use the upside-down card (which remains on Jedi Test).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[It Is The Future You See (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “It Is The Future You See”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[It Is The Future You See (V)]] (published 7 August 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[It Is The Future You See]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
